rights.rightsReviewer: Codex source-page review; per-file license and VRT notice inspected before download
rights.licenseEvidenceSummary: Per-file notice grants sharing and adaptation under CC BY-SA 3.0; commercial reuse permitted subject to attribution, license link, change notice and ShareAlike. The listed VRT ticket confirms the public permission notice; private ticket contents were not accessed.

priorReview.reviewer: Codex technical and visual screening; not specialist clinical sign-off
priorReview.clinicalObservation: Four-chamber geometry with conspicuous wall-thickness pattern; source-labelled severe HCM.
priorReview.overlays: ECHOpedia/provider credits, ECG trace, depth scale and acquisition parameters; color sector/scale where applicable.
priorReview.motionFidelityAssessment: Multiple phases over 2.46 s; no obvious edit cuts; saturation limits endocardial detail.
priorReview.temporalContinuityAssessment: Timestamps strictly increasing; see measured min/max intervals. Visual continuity is provisional, not native acquisition verification.
priorReview.mobileReadabilityAssessment: Narrow 427 px source; broad morphology visible, fine boundaries limited.
priorReview.discriminationTrainingAssessment: Potential wall-thickness contrast; do not infer severity quantitatively.
priorReview.nextStep: Obtain specialist clip/view and teaching-boundary review; prepare and re-review governed derivative only after source gates clear.
